parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: This is the wheel of the cart, made of rubber with a textured surface for traction. It is circular and attached to the front axle.
parts.Functional_description: The wheel allows the cart to roll smoothly and supports the load during movement.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its axle to enable forward and backward motion.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the cart, made of steel, forming the container and handles for carrying loads.
parts.Functional_description: It holds and supports the materials being transported and provides handles for the user to lift and push the cart.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary relative to the wheel, serving as the structural frame of the cart.
